name: Get user info
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current user's identifier and their access rights to custom objects and contact attributes. Use a broader account‑level endpoint (if available) instead when you only need overall account information rather than per‑user flags.

user_id.description: The identifier of the current user (account ID).

has_custom_objects_access.description: Indicates whether the user can access custom objects.

has_contact_attributes_access.description: Indicates whether the user can access contact attributes.
